_about: Performance budgets (milliseconds, the median of midgard_bench's runs), checked by tools/budgets.py. A benchmark fails when it takes longer than its budget plus the margin. 'default' applies everywhere unless a platform has its own value; CI's platforms are named ci-<preset>, and its Linux jobs render with software Vulkan (lavapipe). Budgets are about 2-3 times the slowest CI timing seen (CI runs 38842790692 and, for the job system with a queue per worker, 38845093430; 15 October 2026), so a real slowdown fails but runner noise doesn't. Every benchmark needs a budget.
